newsitem.title: UK: UK's Delphi Group to place shrs at 610p/shr.
newsitem.headline: UK's Delphi Group to place shrs at 610p/shr.

text.p: UK information technology services firm Delphi Group Plc said on Friday it planned to raise about 7.3 milion stg, before expenses, by placing up to 1.2 million ordinary shares at 610p per share.
The company also said it provisionally agreed to acquire an undisclosed U.S. information technology consultancy and staffing business for about $2.6 million in cash.
The 1995 revenues of the business were some $4.8 million with operating profits of about $500,000.
Completion of the acquisition was expected in January.
In addition, the company said it was in the early stages of negotiating two other small acquisitions, one in the UK and one in continental Europe.

The firm said it would initially use the proceeds from the placing to pay down debt. Its unaudited gearing was about 121 percent following its $24.5 million buy earlier this year of Alpine Computer Systems Inc.
The placing will be handled by NatWest Wood Mackenzie & Co Ltd, Delphi said in a statement.
Delphi's shares stood unchanged at 635p at 0915 GMT.
